name: Impact Minerals Limited
summary: Impact Minerals Limited explores for deposits of nickel, gold, copper, silver, lead, zinc, and platinum group elements in Australia and Africa. The company holds interest in the Arkun project covering an area of 1,900 square kilometers; and the Blackridge project that covers an area of 150 square kilometers in the Permian sedimentary rocks near Clermont in central Queensland. It also owns 100% interest in the Broken Hill project covering an area of 816 square kilometers located in New South Wales, as wells holds interests in the Commonwealth project, which covers 903 square kilometers located in Lachlan Fold Belt; and the Clermont project covering an area of 70 square kilometers. Impact Minerals Limited was founded in 2006 and is based in West Perth, Australia.
